name: behavior-viewer
description: Visualizador open source de regras de negocio extraidas de testes BDD.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run typecheck -w packages/domain && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/domain && npm run test -w apps/server && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web && playwright test
